row.name: Contineum Therapeutics Inc. Class A Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=17 breakdowns=7 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=1.05 tightness=1.06 base_volume_vs_leg=1.4 base_volume_vs_avg=1.24
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: 7 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 1.05 of the leg; the base ranged wider than the sessions before it

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close -5.3% vs its 20-SMA, -18.9% over 20 sessions
gain of 16.7% is 15% or more: the worst cell in the only event study, a 36% win rate and -9.3% at 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The base is catastrophically loose: 7 recorded 4%-plus breakdowns inside a 17-session window, a giveback of 1.05 (the entire prior leg was surrendered), and tightness of 1.06 — the base is visibly a declining channel from the August peak down through the $11 area, not a quiet consolidation. The burst bar itself, while closing near its high, is not the widest of the prior five sessions (RE FAIL, vs_prior_5 = 0.74), meaning the expansion is not genuine range expansion out of compression. Together these two hard FAILs make the plan structurally unsound.
claude.key_risk: The base is a multi-week downtrend that gave back the entire prior leg, so any follow-through faces the full weight of overhead supply from $13 to $18.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst-day close of $13.42 or if the first 30 minutes show any reversal back toward the base low.
